uncertain_sources: The dice example near 00:22 is corrupted in the automatic transcript; the chapter retains only the visible misshapen-die experiment and its probability conclusion.
The sector-prior discussion near 00:33 is normalized to p_+/3 and p_-/3 because several mathematical tokens are missing from the transcript.
The friction equation near 00:46 is reconstructed in the standard form m x-double-dot = -gamma x-dot from the audible explanation and board context.

The projection discussion near 01:03 is partially corrupted; the chapter retains the clear distinction between apparent collapse in a reduced projection and Liouville preservation in full phase space.
The transcript says 1/n during the uniform-distribution derivation near 01:15; the chapter uses the consistent probability 1/M.
The coin-count notation near 01:24 is inconsistent in the transcript; the chapter uses n coins and N = 2^n configurations.
Continuous entropy is written with an explicit reference phase-space cell so that the logarithm is dimensionless; setting that cell to one recovers the board shorthand.
The historical aside about Boltzmann's tomb is garbled, so the chapter preserves the entropy formula without claiming an exact inscription.
